t: 后吴泽甸登上唐朝王位并宣布自己为中华帝国的统治者.
te: Empress Wu Zetian ascends to the throne of the Tang dynasty and proclaims herself ruler of the Chinese Empire.
dz: 后吴泽甸登上唐朝王位并宣布自己为中华帝国的统治者.
de: Empress Wu Zetian ascends to the throne of the Tang dynasty and proclaims herself ruler of the Chinese Empire.

t: 武则天皇后建立中国周朝。
te: Empress Wu Zetian establishes the Zhou Dynasty of China.
dz: 武则天皇后建立中国周朝。
de: Empress Wu Zetian establishes the Zhou Dynasty of China.
